pages.text: “Under the scorching sun, across endless dunes, even the toughest life can yield a sweet taste.”$(br2)Cactus Tea is a desert-inspired beverage, brewed from sun-dried cactus flesh, honey, and sugar. It grants the 'Desert Walker' effect, helping travelers adapt to hot environments, though there is a small chance of getting pricked by hidden thorns.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Cactus Tea, $(br)boil sun-dried cactus flesh with honey and sugar.$(br)This drink is best consumed when traveling through deserts, allowing travelers to walk lightly across sand dunes. However, beware—those tiny hidden spines may cause discomfort.

Upon drinking Cactus Tea, travelers gain the 'Desert Walker' effect, making movement easier in desert terrain. However, there is a small chance of taking minor damage.$(br)This tea is ideal for extreme environments, but should be consumed with caution.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
